svg.title: Local LLM triage: decisions by reference class and operational matrices
svg.desc: Pass 1 is drawn once after all values and checks match pass 2. Panel a has three separate count axes for 62 true native alerts, 11 false native alerts, and 15 true declarations. Actions are retain, dismiss, abstain, invalid; the latter two are hatched. Panel b copies the recorded operational matrices for 73 native alerts after conservative fallback, excluding declarations.
svg.metadata: Only numerical source: K_tables/triage_by_class.csv; SHA-256 54e15b97df41c26f5232f477fc2cbf0d95110f9d5dba91dfbfe1ae12dd1aa2e3. Every count is copied from a recorded pass-1 field. No operational matrix was recomputed. Source file-line references are in fig06_values.csv.

g.text: (b) Operational confusion matrices for native alerts after conservative fallback (n = 73)
